name: Tour Perret
elevationDatum: Rigid local exterior foundation plane y=0; metres +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Mapped rotation baked once. No sea-level, DEM or Mercator scaling.
note: Octagonal reinforced-concrete tower with eight vertical ribs, fine chevron screens, an open main gallery, upper cylindrical shaft and open lantern with a small domed crown and needle. Total height is 95 m to tip following Isère tourism, which separately gives 86 m for the main structure; other sources use 90 m or OSM 93 m for the mast. Upper stage splits, chevron pitch, gallery rails and dome profile are photographic estimates, not survey. Permanent restored form only; temporary restoration scaffolding, park furniture and signage omitted. Cityscape: not tested. Full 3D world: not tested.
